messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: DMS and email - Sunday 5 October 02:00-06:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear All,

The document management system and email will be unavailable this Sunday 5 October between 02:00 and 06:00 BST for scheduled maintenance and security patching. Please save and close any open documents before Saturday evening. No action is required.

If you experience issues on Monday morning, please log a ticket with the helpdesk.

Regards,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
